annotatedSchema:
$schema: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema
$id: https://example.org/building-blocks/odrl/constraint-atomic/schema.json
title: ODRL Atomic Constraint
type: object
required:
- leftOperand
- operator
properties:
  leftOperand:
    type: string
  operator:
    type: string
    enum:
    - eq
    - neq
    - gt
    - gteq
    - lt
    - lteq
    - isAnyOf
    - isAllOf
    - isNoneOf
    - gte
    - lte
    - isPartOf
  rightOperand: {}
  rightOperandReference:
    type: string
  unit:
    type: string
  dataType:
    type: string
oneOf:
- required:
  - rightOperand
- required:
  - rightOperandReference
additionalProperties: true
